name: WorkflowTask
description: WorkflowTask represents a single executable step in a workflow.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
Task name/identifier (must be unique within workflow).
 Must be a valid C-style identifier: starts with a letter or underscore,
 followed by letters, digits, or underscores.

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: Task type (determines how to interpret task_config).

fields.name: TaskConfig
fields.description: Task-specific configuration whose structure depends on the `kind` field.

fields.name: Export
fields.description:
Export configuration (how to save task output to context).
 Optional - if not set, output is not saved.

fields.name: Flow
fields.description:
Flow control (which task executes next).
 Optional - if not set, continues to next task in sequence.

fields.name: Compensate
fields.description: Compensation tasks to execute if this task needs to be "undone."
